mintAuthority.summary: inALPHA is a non-upgradeable BoringVault on Ethereum. Shares are minted only via the enter() function, which requires authorization from a RolesAuthority contract (0x5e500500968388a13b3ff885c3eed7158a5d82ef). The sole authorized Teller is TellerWithMultiAssetSupportPredicateProxy (0x6104fe10ca937a086ba7AdbD0910A4733d380cB6). Vault owner is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982).

controls.evidence: Safe API at Ethereum block 25,296,225: Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0), threshold 3-of-6, 6 owners, no modules, no guard, nonce 151. This Safe is owner() of the BoringVault and controls the RolesAuthority.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Plume reads on 2026-07-14 confirmed the inALPHA vault at 0x64ab176c...b855 has direct runtime code, zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots, no UUPS interface, Safe owner 0xa08a0dc4...a982, and RolesAuthority 0x5e500500...82ef on both chains. The authorized teller at 0x6104fe10...0cb6 has identical runtime bytecode on both chains, zero EIP-1967 slots, no UUPS interface, and the same Safe owner. The mint-critical vault and teller implementations are therefore immutable on both tracked deployments; the Safe can still change authorization through the separately reviewed RolesAuthority control path. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nALPHA supply to its multi-asset portfolio was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer.
